'''Scraife''' was a male [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] Lieutenant of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] by the Sith Empire.<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|Prison Repairs|Belsavis}}</ref>
